full_judgment: 3. The defendant-petitioners contested the suit by filing written statement in denial of the plaintiffs case and stating that the land which was in fact requisitioned and acquisitioned that had been delivered and not the suit land. In this context on the date of final hearing the plaintiffs already examined his witnesses. At that stage on an application of the plaintiff to prove and bring into records those 2 exhibits the 1st impugned order was passed allowing the plaintiff for the same and by the 2nd impugned order those 2 documents were proved and made exhibits by recalling PW 1. Ext. 22 is the proclamation of attachment of the land of suit khatian in the name of Ujir Bibi including the suit land, in a certificate case. Ext. (23) is the order sheet of LA Case 23 of 1949-50 dated 5.2.52. Both the Exts. are public documents and have been brought to show ownership of Ujir Bibi the predecessor-in- interest of the plaintiff in the suit holding.
